catalogue.empty: No items are available right now.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
auth.name: Full name

auth.intro: One account to manage your relationship with Lease Loop.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.registerError: We could not create your account. Check your details, or sign in if you already have an account.
auth.loginError: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password.

account.title: My account
account.intro: Manage your profile and account security. Your leasing journey will live here.
account.updateError: We could not save your changes. Check your details and, if changing your password, your current password.
account.passwordNote: Changing your password signs out your other devices.
dashboard.title: Your leasing space
dashboard.intro: Everything you need to follow your leases.
dashboard.emptyText: Your leases will appear here once your agreement is ready.
dashboard.demoExplanation: Development demo: creates simulated lease and payment records for your account. No real asset or payment is affected.
dashboard.demoError: The demo could not be created. Check that the database is set up.
dashboard.demoNotice: Demo lease: the agreement, invoice and payment are simulated.
dashboard.paymentsIntro: Issued invoices and recorded payments. Forecasts are shown on each lease.
dashboard.noInvoices: No invoices have been issued yet.
dashboard.requestsIntro: Requests are reviewed before your agreement changes.
dashboard.noRequests: You have no requests yet. Open a lease to request a change.
dashboard.requestSent: Request sent. Your current lease remains active while it is reviewed.
dashboard.requestUnavailable: A request is already pending or this lease is no longer active.
dashboard.requestError: We could not send the request. Please try again.
dashboard.lockedExplanation: Your net rent is locked in the agreement. VAT is calculated for each invoice date.
dashboard.forecastTotalNote: Includes the net down payment and forecast monthly invoices; excludes the optional buyout. Future VAT may change.
dashboard.forecastUnavailable: A forecast is unavailable because a VAT rate is missing.
dashboard.vatExplanation: Net rent is locked; the VAT rate on each invoice date determines the tax. The 2027 rate is fictional.
dashboard.forecastNote: These are estimates, not issued invoices. VAT may change.
dashboard.manageInfo: Choose an option to request a review. Your current agreement continues until a change is approved.
dashboard.returnTerms: Any return charges are determined after review.
dashboard.buyoutTerms: End-of-term price: {amount} excl. VAT. An early buyout requires a separate quote.
dashboard.exchangeTerms: Replacement availability and any charges need review.
dashboard.passportIntro: Current item details and its previous lease count.
dashboard.impactNote: Estimate for this reuse life, assuming one refurbishment and using fictional manufacturing factors adjusted for condition. It is not a measured saving.
dashboard.noImpact: No reuse saving is estimated for the first life. Factors are fictional.
dashboard.noEvents: No events have been recorded yet.
photo.title: Photo credits
photo.intro: These photographs illustrate fictional products; they do not show the actual items. Images have been resized for the site.
product.estimate: Estimate only, excluding VAT. This does not reserve the item or lock its price.
product.unavailable: This item is not currently available to lease. You can still explore pricing.
product.error.below_minimum: The financed amount is below the leasing minimum. Reduce your down payment.
product.error.above_maximum: The financed amount exceeds the leasing maximum. Increase your down payment.
product.error.unknown_term: This lease term is not supported.
product.error.invalid_down_payment: Choose a down payment between zero and the list price.
product.intro: Choose your term and down payment. See your monthly rent change as you adjust.
product.description.e_bike: Check the distance ridden, condition and previous leases to get to know this e-bike.
product.description.laptop: Review the battery cycles, condition and model year of this laptop.
product.description.farm_machine: Review the engine hours, condition and model year of this farm machine.
product.endIntro: At the end of your lease, choose the next step under your contract.
product.end.buy.title: Make it yours
product.end.buy.body: Buy the item at the end-of-term buyout price agreed in your contract.
product.end.return.title: Return it
product.end.return.body: Return the item so it can be assessed, refurbished and leased again.
product.end.pass.title: Pass it on
product.end.pass.body: Explore a transfer to another customer, subject to approval and the terms of your contract.
